description: Exact ledger of every question considered for the development evaluation, including the cases dropped or replaced before scoring. A dropped case is recorded with the evidence that made it unscorable; it is never counted as a success or a failure. The scored set is fixtures/answer_semantics/questions.json (24 questions).

development_set.note: No scored question reached gold_inconsistent: every reviewed printed cell agreed with the XBRL fact of the same accession within one printed unit.

entries.detail: Walmart prints both 'Net sales' (605,881) and 'Total revenues' (611,289). The shared vocabulary carries 'total revenue' in the singular, so the plural total does not reach the exact-alias tier and the resolver returns the Net sales component instead. Adding the alias after seeing the corpus would tune the development set; the question is recorded here and left unscored, and the gap is reported as a limitation.

Deere prints 'Net cash provided by operating activities' twice: 1,820.3 in the consolidated statement and 3,278.9 in the equipment-operations statement. Neither table carries a statement title the classifier recognises, so both candidates have an unknown family and neither scope can be preferred on evidence. Refusing is correct behaviour but it is not a resolution; the question is left unscored rather than counted as a justified abstention.

Deere's statement prints 'Net income' 2,370.6 (ProfitLoss, the consolidated total) and 'Net income attributable to Deere & Company' 2,368.4 (NetIncomeLoss). The two tags are different concepts, so neither can be declared the gold for a question that says only 'net income'. Replaced by IBM FY2018 net income (AS-13), where NetIncomeLoss is the only net-income tag in the filing.

IBM FY2017 gross profit is 36,227 in the FY2018 filing and 36,943 in the FY2019 filing, both for the same period end. A resolver that picks one and asserts it is wrong for at least one vintage; the question is scored as an abstention class and both resolvers are credited only if they refuse with a conflict.
Chevron prints no gross-profit subtotal: the concept does not exist in the filing. Abstention is the only truthful response, and an answered response is counted as unsupported.
